items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...is it that in your book, Barbara, that you read?

ctx.x: But I mean the fella I always played, I didn't find out that John, John, Gundolfa, anyway, Gundolfa. Joe Gundolfa, I asked you about it. They have different bands every Saturday night. Yeah, I should play out on the lake for them all, every Sunday, pretty much when you didn't have to play a parade or something, but down the street show. But see how it goes them days, if you signed a contract with a man there for advertising and another man wants you for a parade, why don't you just call up some of the other…
You better get some of it. I didn't ever know what it was. I didn't never know what it was. Too bad we never will know. Maybe something, is it that in your book, Barbara, that you read? Luck powder?
Yeah, or something that you chew. It doesn't say anything about chewing it, but they sure sell it over at the Cracker Jacks. Yeah, up there on that pole.
